cards.title: Tank-Style Water Heaters
cards.description: Cold water enters through a dip tube to the bottom of the tank, while hot water is drawn off the top — so you get full-temperature water until most of the tank is used. We can also install a mixing valve on your existing unit to deliver up to 50% more hot water by mixing it with cold downstream of the tank, reducing strain on the heater.
items: Mixing valve upgrades for 50% more hot water

cards.title: Tankless Water Heaters
cards.description: Tankless systems heat water on demand instead of constantly heating a stored tank. The right candidate can save substantially on monthly bills, conserve natural gas, and enjoy unlimited hot water. Tankless units also last 5–10 years longer than tank heaters and take up far less space.
